args.title: Use the correct base URL in password reset emails instead of localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the base URL used in the password reset email template from a hardcoded localhost fallback to the configured deployment URL. This will prevent emails from containing links to localhost, which do not work for users. The base URL should default to the environment variable PUBLIC_URL if set, ensuring links in emails point to the actual production host rather than localhost.
